summary: Frontend-only verification of the branding/colour refinement on build-beyond-living.html (header logo restored to design.html asset, Nova-branded app mockup, per-screen old-money accents, Reservations hierarchy) plus a light regression. All 10 spec areas were executed with Playwright at 320/375/390/430/1440. Everything requested passes; only one soft criterion (in-app mobile font-size >= 8px) is not met, plus two minor design observations. Zero console/page errors anywhere.

issues: In-app text falls below the requested 8px floor: bottom nav 4.91px (320) / 6.11px (390) / 6.38px (430), .bb-ui-wordmark 5.41-7.04px, .bb-ui-time 6.77px, .bb-ui-assist 6.43px, .bb-ui-status & .bb-ui-btn 7.09-7.70px. Rendered legibly as a mockup but does not satisfy the '>= 8px inside the screen' acceptance criterion.

'Restaurant Reservation' sub-line is 9.12px at rgba(41,41,39,.56) — very low contrast against the ivory card; hierarchy is correct (14.4px name > 9.12px kind) but the middle line is close to invisible at 1440.
Large empty gap (~250px at 1440) between the last list row and the bottom nav; screens look sparse compared to Concierge/Reservations. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: bump the mobile in-app font scale so no text inside .bb-phone-screen computes below 8px (bottom nav is the worst at 4.9px on 320px).
Optional: raise the opacity of .bb-ui-res-kind (currently .56) for readability.
Optional: reduce the vertical dead space on the Home Services / Support screens.
critical_code_review_comments: build-beyond-living.html line 57 (and design.html line 60) emit a malformed logo tag: . Browsers recover, but the stray '/' turns into a bogus attribute — build_bbl.py's logo swap should produce well-formed markup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 10 requested checks pass functionally; 1 soft design criterion (>=8px in-app font) not met

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found. The only unmet criterion is typographic: the in-app font scale is driven by the phone width, so at 320-430px viewports several app labels compute between 4.9px and 7.7px, below the requested 8px floor.
